==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
* He can now inflict bleed on his primary target, starting [[Update Log#Update_Halloween_-_Halloween_2022_Update|Halloween update]].
*After the release of [[Blood (Unleashed)]] he can deal much higher DPS because [[Blood (Unleashed)]]] buffs all bleed damage by 5x. This buff combined with Levi’s 50% CRIT chance to deal 2x Damage makes him a pretty solid unit, although he can't do extra bleed damage to flying enemies due to [[Blood (Unleashed)]] not being able to hit flying enemies.
*{{PAGENAME}} is the only crit unit in the game that deals 2x damage on crit unlike the usual 1.5x most units have.
